title: Fix street-level zoom error in CustomMapView

requirements.text: Fix the error that occurs when zooming to street level on the community map. Audit and correct tile URL computation, zoom level capping, and Web Mercator math in CustomMapView, useMapTiles, and useMapTransform so that zooming to the maximum supported zoom level (19) works without errors or broken tiles.

quotes: the error was not fixed try again

acceptanceCriteria: User can zoom from overview level all the way to street level (zoom 19) without any runtime error or crash.
Map tiles load correctly at all zoom levels up to 19.
No console errors related to tile URL construction or invalid zoom values.
Pan and zoom interactions remain smooth at maximum zoom level.
Zoom controls (in/out/reset) function correctly at all zoom levels including the maximum.

constraints: Do not change the backend schema or any backend Motoko files.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Adding new map features or UI beyond fixing the zoom error.
Switching tile providers or changing the CartoDB Voyager tile source.
